                                                                  Airworthiness Directive
                                                                  AD No.:              2026-0200

         Design Approval Holder’s Name:                                                    Type/Model designation(s):
         AIRBUS S.A.S.                                                                     A330-841 and A330-941 aeroplanes

         Effective Date:                 03 November 2026
         Foreign AD:                     Not applicable
         Supersedure:                    None

         Applicability:
         Airbus A330-841 and A330-941 aeroplanes, manufacturer serial numbers (MSN) 1819, 1836, 1844,
         1850, 1861, 1870, 1876, 1884, 1887, 1890, 1892, 1895, 1897, 1900, 1901, 1903, 1904, 1906, 1908,
         1909, 1910, 1913, 1914, 1915, 1918, 1920, 1921, 1922, 1923, 1924, 1925, 1926, 1927, 1929, 1931,
         1933, 1934, 1935, 1937, 1938, 1939, 1941, 1943, 1946, 1947, 1948, 1949, 1952, 1953, 1954, 1956,
         1957, 1958, 1959, 1961, 1962, 1963, 1964, 1966, 1969, 1971, 1972, 1977 and 1979.
